items.title: Asa in his latter years
items.charge: Hiring the king of Syria against Israel; imprisoning the seer who reproved him; seeking to the physicians and not to the Lord

items.title: Eliashib and Tobiah the Ammonite
items.charge: Lodging an Ammonite enemy in a chamber of the house of God; a priest's house allied to Sanballat

items.title: Jehoshaphat's alliances
items.charge: Joining affinity with Ahab; going to Ramoth-gilead with him; joining with Ahaziah to make ships

items.title: Peter at Antioch
items.charge: Dissembling: withdrawing from the Gentiles for fear of them of the circumcision

items.title: Simon Magus
items.charge: Offering money for the gift of the Holy Ghost

items.title: The churches of Ephesus, Sardis, and Laodicea
items.charge: Leaving the first love; a name to live while dead; lukewarm, and saying, I am rich

items.title: The lord on whose hand the king leaned
items.charge: Scoffing at the word of the Lord by Elisha in the famine of Samaria

items.title: The Sabbath traders of Jerusalem and Tyre
items.charge: Treading winepresses, bringing in sheaves, and selling fish and wares on the Sabbath

items.title: The Samaritan village, and the sons of thunder
items.charge: Refusing to receive him because his face was toward Jerusalem; James and John asking for fire from heaven

items.title: Zacharias
items.charge: Not believing the words of the angel Gabriel, and asking for a sign
